description: Which set-operation spellings are accepted, with which rows and error numbers: parenthesized arms (both, and the second only), UNION DISTINCT, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, MINUS, UNION CORRESPONDING, a trailing semicolon after three UNION ALL arms, TABLE as an arm after UNION and in both arms of UNION ALL, a dangling UNION (with and without a following arm), a UNION as a derived table, and a UNION as the child of IN and of EXISTS? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
